scenario: LCON.4.4.1 fact-stream primitive — the runtime records the fact stream losslessly and replays it bit-identically (LCON.4.4.2). A rule deriving a fact across two triggers is recorded and replayed; the lossless round-trip is proven by the recorded and replayed streams matching event-for-event (handles normalized).
rules_ds:
schema Trigger scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Derived scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule derive:
    Trigger t
->
    emit Derived logical v: t.v
